welcome:
Welcome to the GCP CLI Playground.
Type commands to explore a simulated Google Cloud environment.
Type 'help' for available commands, 'scenario' for guided labs.

steps.instruction: First, check which GCP project and account you are working with.
List GKE clusters to find the production cluster in asia-south1.
Get credentials for the prod-payments-cluster so kubectl can connect.
steps.expect: gcloud container clusters get-credentials prod-payments-cluster --region asia-south1 --project bfsi-prod-384209
steps.hint: Try: gcloud container clusters get-credentials prod-payments-cluster --region asia-south1 --project bfsi-prod-384209

steps.instruction: The SRE on-call reported high error rates. Check Cloud Logging for recent errors in the payments service.
steps.expect: gcloud logging read 'resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.cluster_name="prod-payments-cluster" AND severity>=ERROR' --limit=10 --format=json
steps.hint: Try: gcloud logging read 'resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.cluster_name="prod-payments-cluster" AND severity>=ERROR' --limit=10 --format=json

steps.instruction: Logs point to a Cloud SQL connection timeout. Check the Cloud SQL instance status.
The txn-ledger-db instance looks degraded. Describe it for more detail.
steps.hint: Try: gcloud sql instances describe txn-ledger-db --format=yaml

steps.instruction: Check the Compute Engine instances backing additional services to see if anything else is affected.
The reconciliation-worker VM is stopped. Restart it to restore the batch pipeline.
steps.hint: Try: gcloud compute instances start reconciliation-worker --zone=asia-south1-a

steps.instruction: Verify your authenticated identity and the active project before deploying.
Set the project to the staging environment for the deployment.
steps.hint: Try: gcloud config set project bfsi-staging-384210

steps.instruction: List existing Cloud Run services to see what is already deployed.
Create a service account for the new kyc-verification service.
steps.expect: gcloud iam service-accounts create kyc-verification-sa --display-name="KYC Verification Service Account"
steps.hint: Try: gcloud iam service-accounts create kyc-verification-sa --display-name="KYC Verification Service Account"

steps.instruction: Deploy the KYC verification service to Cloud Run.
Verify the deployment by listing revisions of the new service.
Upload the API spec to Cloud Storage for documentation.
Check monitoring dashboards to confirm the service is healthy.

Available commands:
  gcloud config list/set           — View or set CLI configuration properties
  gcloud auth list/login           — Manage authentication
  gcloud projects list             — List accessible projects
  gcloud compute instances         — Manage Compute Engine VMs (list, describe, ssh, start, stop)
  gcloud container clusters        — Manage GKE clusters (list, get-credentials)
  gcloud run                       — Manage Cloud Run services (deploy, services list, revisions list)
  gcloud iam service-accounts      — Manage service accounts (list, create)
  gcloud logging read              — Read Cloud Logging entries
  gcloud monitoring dashboards     — List monitoring dashboards
  gcloud storage ls/cp             — Manage Cloud Storage objects
  gcloud sql instances             — Manage Cloud SQL instances (list, describe)
  gcloud functions                 — Manage Cloud Functions (deploy, list)

  scenario                         — Start a guided lab
  clear                            — Clear the terminal
  help                             — Show this help
